post_text: April 7, 2026 at 7:39 PM#1Hello,I need a Macro which change the Fade Times of all Cues in the Sequences which assigned to the Executors 5.1 Thru 5.30.Some Executors in this range are empty and I get "Error #28: No Cue Source given" when I try it with my Command "Assign Executor 5.1 Thru 5.30 Cue 1 Thru * /Fade = (Fadetime)".The weird thing is that this command works in some of my showfiles, but not in all of them, but the execs in the file are assigned equal.
